detection_tier: 3 -- flat structured file, per the kernel storage-agnostic detection_policy
store_location: sidecar file created beside the package on first write; never inside the package
why_sidecar: A control package is versioned and immutable and carries declared hashes. A decision log grows on every generation. Writing the log into the package would invalidate its hashes on every job.
metadata_discipline: Every field is logic-derived from the real current task. A genuinely unknown field is marked UNKNOWN, never guessed and never filled with a placeholder value.
entries_note: No seed entries. Fabricating precedent would violate the Module 15 metadata rule and would poison the first real decision with invented history. The log is empty until the first genuine generation.
upgrade_path: If a Dataverse table or SharePoint list becomes available, detection_policy tiers 1 and 2 take priority over this file. Migrate entries by canonical field name; the schema is identical.
